prompt: Implement a GreenGate Offline Operations Suite for an independent venue and retail operator that sells floral products, manages on-site events with e-ticket entry, and maintains a small portfolio of rentable spaces. The app runs on iPhone and iPad and supports portrait/landscape with Split View on iPad; all screens follow Apple Human Interface Guidelines with Dark Mode support and Dynamic Type scaling. Users authenticate locally with username + password (minimum 8 characters, at least one number) and can unlock sensitive actions using FaceID/TouchID via LocalAuthentication, with haptic feedback for scan success/failure. Core roles include Administrator (full access), Cashier (POS checkout, returns, shift close), Gate Attendant (ticket validation only), Content Manager (create/edit listings, products, learning content), and Reviewer (moderation and approvals). The business flow centers on four daily tasks: maintaining a Product Center for flowers/bouquets using SPU-SKU specs (stem count, wrap type, color), price, taxability, on-hand inventory with low-stock alerts at 10 units, and listing/delisting approval; running POS Checkout with fast barcode lookup, cart with per-item and order-level discounts capped at 30%, coupon codes with local validity dates, cash rounding to the nearest $0.01, parked tickets that auto-expire after 30 minutes of inactivity, returns/exchanges that require original-order lookup and block refunds past 30 days; managing E-ticketing with on-device QR/barcode generation, anti-counterfeit signatures, validity windows (e.g., 03/27/2026 6:00 PM–10:00 PM), and check-in that blocks duplicate validations while logging who scanned and when; and maintaining Property Listings full lifecycle (US address, square footage in sq ft, floor plan attachments, amenities, rent/deposit, lease term availability) with publish/unpublish/lock, status workflow (Draft → In Review → Published → Locked), and an auditable change history visible to Admin/Reviewer. Data persists entirely on-device using UIKit for the interface and Core Data for storage, with no server backend, remote database, or third-party services. Core Data entities include ProductSPU, ProductSKU, InventoryLot, PriceRule/Coupon, Order, PaymentRecord (supports split tender records like cash + card-on-file placeholder without online processing), TicketEvent, ETicket, CheckInLog, PropertyListing, Attachment, and AuditLog; all write operations generate immutable audit rows with timestamp and local user ID. Attachments (images/video/audio and PDFs) are stored in the app sandbox with SHA-256 deduplication, licensing/copyright fields, and local transcoding/compression to target outputs (e.g., image max 2048 px long edge, JPEG quality 0.8; video stored at 720p), plus thumbnail generation; a cleanup job removes orphaned files after 7 days. Bulk Import/Export supports offline CSV/Excel file intake via Files app, pre-import validation (required fields, formats, duplicate SKU/barcode checks, option validity, and quality score thresholds like minimum 70/100), producing an on-device error report and allowing partial success with a transaction summary; exports can filter by status/date and optionally mask sensitive fields (e.g., renter phone shown as ***-***-1234). Performance targets include cold start under 1.5 seconds with a lightweight launch database fetch, memory warning handling that clears image caches, and background task management for long imports, thumbnailing, and end-of-day summaries, pausing work when battery is low and resuming safely without data loss.
